interface.signature: countVertex(N: int, edges: List[Tuple[int, int]]) -> int

preconditions.description: The number of nodes N must be between 1 and 100,000.
The number of edges must be exactly N - 1, as the graph is a valid tree.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= N and 1 <= v <= N for u, v in edges)
preconditions.description: All nodes in the edges must be valid node indices between 1 and N.

postconditions.description: The output must be the string representation of the minimum number of nodes selected.
The minimum number of nodes selected must be at least 1.
The minimum number of nodes selected must not exceed the total number of nodes N.
